applies_to: ES ordinary-volume cohort, before any formal trial
reason: Initial mixed direct calibration exhausted six attempts without reaching 0.10 process CPU; 30s no-business-load original-observer baseline measured 0.017177 cores and did not support the proposed observer CPU floor.
instrumentation: Keep original full ES stats cadence and subsecond process/cgroup sampling; no baseline subtraction or CPU-normalized throughput.
continuation: Same owned database container, Java PID/start ticks, ordinary volume and actual quotas; exact labelled fixture adoption gives cleanup responsibility to one continuation coordinator.
common_warm: One additional 60s mixed prewarm at a previously healthy 220 requests/sec, implemented as direct 30s and Weir 30s before recalibration; preserve both as prewarm, outside formal results. This split was accepted before formal trials.
calibration_budget: Use round 1 of the existing at-most-two recalibration rounds for both paths after initial calibration failure. Each path gets at most six pilots per round. Round 2 is the only remaining recalibration budget for this workload, including complete-pair replacement after a formal CPU or health failure.
preservation: Keep initial calibration failures, rejected observer-floor hypothesis, safe handoff records and interrupted r008 raw evidence. No formal result existed before this addendum.
target_and_formal_protocol: Unchanged: actual process CPU 0.10 cores +/-5%, pair difference <=5%, fixed 20s warm / 60s measure, D-W / W-D / D-W, separate health gate. Report unmatched if the bounded calibration cannot qualify.
